scope: official synthetic repositories and fresh keys; no real identity/tenant, no lifespan

console_bootstrap.condition: If enabled and reachable without authenticated upstream boundary, caller-supplied identity can mint a token. No upstream boundary is established by this app.

diagnosis_dev.condition: DEV naming is not an environment/identity guard; actual production-env Srv05 mounts and executes fake adapter.

gupshup.condition: Source has no signature/env gate before inbound claim and Flow bridge. No inbound mutation was attempted.

flow.evidence: Full Gate hardening tests: non-DEV default_admin rejected; authenticated default

embed.evidence: HMAC/origin deny, tamper, override tests; real browser HMAC passes

debug_schema_health.evidence: debug default off; OpenAPI and health mounted; ingress policy must be explicit
